memory availability does not create retrieval duty
use a representation sufficiently rich for the current criterion
do not silently reuse a prior projection for a new criterion
prefer exact/current source over summary for consequential transitions
stop when more context cannot change the next material action, requisite evidence/authorization, material risk, or stop condition

design_bias: progressive disclosure; non-collapse; preserve provenance/currentness; no proceduralization without observed need
mutation_rule: change the sandbox only when ordinary work exposes material friction, failure, stale-state risk, or a demonstrably simpler sufficient form
